Author: deserokk
Name: DeserokUtils
Description:
A small personal set of utilities. /dsu opens the window.

CastWatch: a consistent way to announce spells.
Mouseover: mouseover macros in one line, with a fallback.
FateWatch: a timer for FATEs that run on a cycle.
FcBuffs: keeps the Free Company buffs topped up.
DrawSheathe: a draw/sheathe key that incorporates the Gold Saucer emotes.
EmoteQuiet: stops emote spam in your log.
Interact: an interact key that ignores open menus and advances dialogue.
EphemeralMarks: private markers for the people you queued in with.
DebuffMarks: a private icon over anyone with a debuff you name.
AchievementData: makes achievement links in chat work.
PartyJobs: shows the job of party members who are not in your zone.
Keybinds: bind these to a key instead of a hotbar macro.
MeldWindow: reopens the meld window after each meld when melding for someone else.
Repairs: accepts party members' repair requests without the confirmation box.
Items: /dsuitem uses an item on a target from a macro, which the game has no command for.
Macro icons: lets /micon name an item, and names an iconless macro after itself.
Dresser: finds loose pieces in your dresser and bags that make up an outfit, and packs them for you. Hovering any item anywhere says whether you already own that appearance.

Author: Lynesth, maintained by Khayle (PvP patch by deserokk)
Name: Better Targeting System (PvP)
Description: A fork of Better Targeting System that also runs in PvP. Only the target selection (camera-cone + proximity) is affected - no combat mechanics change.
Punchline: Intelligent tab-targeting, also enabled in PvP.

Author: deserokk
Name: Fanfare
Description:
Changes achievement notifications to a stylized, console-adjacent popup with definable sounds.
Six chimes are included; point it at your own file in the settings.
Punchline: Achievements deserve better than a line of chat text

Author: deserokk
Name: DesCast
Description: Flat screens placed anywhere in a house, correctly hidden by walls and people. Shows an image or a rotating set, from your PC or a link, and a whole room of them can be shared with your Free Company from one file.
Punchline: Screens, signage and shared boards for your house
